name: 10_queue_sessionless_item_is_quarantined
why: An item whose owning conversation cannot be PROVEN must never be written anywhere: the container, the neighbouring item's session or the client's last registered session would each merge two conversations. It goes to quarantine/ intact, is never retried, and stays visible until a human decides. Item a drains first ON PURPOSE - that is what leaves a session registered on the shared client, the exact precondition under which the sessionless item used to be silently absorbed.

items.body: orphan turn with no provable owner

on_failure: If `b` shows up in attempted/persisted, that implementation attributed an orphan turn to somebody else's conversation - stop and fix it before running the plugin again. If second_drain_attempted is not empty, quarantine is being retried, which is the loop that used to burn a request on every single run. If b is in pending_after instead of quarantined_after, it will be retried forever and the queue never drains.
